R33_theory.white_variance: sigma_y(t)^2 = V_true^2*sigma_I^2 + I_true^2*sigma_V^2 + sigma_V^2*sigma_I^2 + sum_j(omega_true_j^2*sigma_tau_j^2 + tau_true_j^2*sigma_omega_j^2 + sigma_tau_j^2*sigma_omega_j^2), independent white errors assumption
R33_theory.oracle_coefficients_SE: For X_true (n x 5): cov(beta_hat|X_true)=(X'X)^(-1) X' diag(sigma_y(t)^2) X (X'X)^(-1); sqrt diagonal = idealized coefficient SE. If rank deficient record NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. X_true computed only from training/reference physical profiles after manifest seal; cannot claim observed-X SE equals oracle.
R33_theory.sensor_persistent_bias: Delta R33(t)= -sum_j(delta_tau_j*omega_true_j + tau_true_j*delta_omega_j + delta_tau_j*delta_omega_j). Episode-level biases do NOT shrink as 1/sqrt(n). Compare bias-on/off; no assertion of low severity identifiability.
R33_theory.auxiliary_AR1: For AR(1) sampled with rho=phi_aux_per_second^dt_s, add covariance Sigma_aux_ij=sigma_a^2*rho^abs(i-j) to measured residual: cov(beta)=(X'X)^-1 X'(Sigma_white+Sigma_aux)X(X'X)^-1. Var(mean_aux)=sigma_a^2/n^2*(n+2sum_h(n-h)*rho^h); n_eff asymptotically n(1-rho)/(1+rho), not n.
R33_theory.interpretation: Oracle regressor+white-only SE optimistic: observed regressors have errors-in-variables and persistent bias; serial auxiliary nuisance reduces effective information. M01/I01 low-severity may be indistinguishable. Report required effect size |Delta beta| / theoretical SE, rank/collinearity and confidence intervals by episode, with/without bias.
R33_theory.numeric_coeff_SE_status: NOT AVAILABLE before physical reference trajectory and design matrix; no episodes/coefficients yet run.

manifest.structural_mode_rule: Lexicographically sorted 2*2*2 combos. For each class/split/severity quota, rotate by first byte of SHA256('TAYCAN4R|struct|hypothesis|split|severity') mod 8. Train 2*8+4 nominal, validation 8+2 nominal. Test 2 blocks each containing 8 nominal and 8 shifted, every combo exactly once per profile per block.
manifest.phi_rule: For each hypothesis and split, global within-hypothesis index=(stratum index)*n_per_stratum+replicate; offset first byte SHA256('TAYCAN4R|phi|hypothesis|split') mod 7; phi=grid[(global_index+offset)%7].
manifest.seed_rule: uint32(first 8 hex of SHA256('TAYCAN4R|hypothesis|split|severity_or_H00_quota|replicate_decimal|stream')), where streams physics,observer,aux,nuisance and replicate zero-based decimal unpadded; collision across ANY splits/streams => FAIL-STOP, no silent retry.
manifest.nuisance_rule: Derive continuous draws using xorshift32 stream from seed_nuisance; fixed 9-value order rpm noise, rpm persistent bias range, torque noise, torque persistent bias range, SOC group bias SD, SOC innovation, auxiliary phi, auxiliary innovation, auxiliary cap; use sealed parameter ranges, serialize 8 decimals. Continuous biases per channel drawn later from the same frozen stream.
QC: per hypothesis and severity test has 2 blocks each with 8 nominal+8 shifted and 8 structural modes

execution_order: Check sealed parent SHA, amended SHA, stage3 model hash
Create deterministic manifest and independent receipt; FAIL on QC failure
Calibrate H00 battery-side charge power separately for each profile using frozen 8-12-iteration bisector; report SOC convergence
Only then generate fault and H00 episodes. No retroactive parameter retuning.
